title: Set Positive Expectations
description: To harness the Pygmalion Effect: - Encourage: Set realistic but optimistic expectations for others. - Support: Provide feedback and resources to help them succeed. - Monitor: Ensure your expectations align with their actual strengths and goals. Example: If mentoring someone, focus on their potential and emphasize progress over perfection.
